column1: # Pinned license sources — the trust anchor for everything license-setup writes.
#   sha256-of-file  exact bytes of the upstream file, as published. Verifies licenses/<id>.txt and any
#                   copy fetched over the network. If upstream ever changes, this MUST fail — re-pinning
#                   is a deliberate act (`get-license.sh pin`), never an automatic one.
#                   digest of the text after dropping the Apache appendix, dropping standalone
#                   `Copyright ...` lines, and collapsing whitespace. This is what a *repository's*
#                   LICENSE is verified against: the copyright holder legitimately varies and the text
#                   may be rewrapped, but not one operative word may differ.
# Rows are added by `get-license.sh pin <ID> [url]`, never typed by hand: a digest typed from memory is
# the same failure mode as license text written from memory.
